Reasoning/count: Count according to each connection between non-hydrogen atoms; a double bond is counted as one non-hydrogen-bond connection. Right carbonyl and lower ester: right carbonyl C=O 1, right carbonyl C-Ph 1; lower ester C=O 1, lower ester carbonyl C-O 1, lower O-Et carbon 1, C-C within the lower Et 1, total 6, cumulative 18. raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Perform a direct non-hydrogen bond enumeration on the image. Starting at the left EtO ester, count the Et C–C and C–O bonds, the O–carbonyl C bond, the left C=O bond, the carbonyl C–alkyl C bond, the alkyl C–S bond, and the S–central C bond. Continue through the central framework: central lower C–central upper C, central upper C–O−, central upper C–Ph, central upper C–right carbonyl C, and central lower C–CO2Et carbonyl C. Then add the right carbonyl C=O and carbonyl C–Ph bonds and the lower ester C=O and C–OEt bonds. Finally add internal Ph ring bonds for the two Ph groups and internal Et bonds for the two Et groups. The total should be 30.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态结构；左侧是 EtO 酯基 EtO-C(=O)-CH2-，该 CH2 连到 S，S 再连到中央下方碳。中央下方碳连中央上方碳，并向下连一个 CO2Et 酯基。中央上方碳连 O−、一个 Ph、以及右侧羰基；右侧羰基还连一个 Ph。图中的弯箭头不作为键计数。推理/计数：按非氢原子之间每条键连接计数，双键作为一条非氢键连接计入。左侧 EtO 酯及到硫/中央的连接：Et 内 C-C 1，Et C-O 1，O-羰基 C 1，左侧 C=O 1，羰基 C-烷基 C 1，烷基 C-S 1，S-中央 C 1，共 7。中央框架：中央下 C-中央上 C 1，中央上 C-O− 1，中央上 C-Ph 1，中央上 C-右羰基 C 1，中央下 C-CO2Et 羰基 C 1，共 5，累计 12。右侧和下方羰基/酯连接：右羰基 C=O 1，右羰基 C-Ph 1，下方酯 C=O 1，下方酯 C-OEt 1，共 4，累计 16。两个 Ph 环内部各有 6 条 C-C 键，共 12，累计 28。两个 Et 基内部各有 1 条 C-C 键，共 2，累计 30。因此总非氢键数为 30。
